models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email and password authentication credentials and user profile information.

This actor table stores the core identity for users who can create, manage, and track their private todos in the application. Each member has unique email credentials for login, a hashed password for secure authentication, and an optional display name for their profile.

Account lifecycle follows registration → active → deletion pattern. When a member deletes their account, associated {@link todo_app_todos} and {@link todo_app_edit_histories} are cascade-deleted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description:
Unique email address used for member login and account identification.

This field serves as the primary login identifier for members. Each email must be unique across all member accounts to ensure proper authentication and account isolation. Email is immutable after registration.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description:
Hashed password for secure authentication.

The password hash is computed using a secure hashing algorithm (e.g., bcrypt, argon2) during registration. This field stores only the hash, never plain-text passwords. Updated when members change their passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description:
Optional display name for the member's profile.

Allow members to set a personalized name for their profile. The display name can be left empty or updated at any time by the member.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the member account was created.

This records the exact time the member account was registered. The timestamp is set automatically during account creation and never changes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

This tracks when any field on the member account was modified, such as display name changes. Updates automatically on every mutation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Nullable timestamp when the member account was soft-deleted.

When a member deletes their account, this field is set to the deletion timestamp. A value of NULL means the account is active. When set, the account enters a deleted state where all associated {@link todo_app_todos} and {@link todo_app_edit_histories} are cascade-deleted.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated member users, storing IP address, page URL, referrer, and expiration time for each login session.

Each session is tied to exactly one {@link todo_app_members} account and serves as the authentication context when members access their private todo list, edit history, and account management features. Sessions are append-only records created during login and logically terminated during logout.

No updated_at or deleted_at fields are present since sessions are never modified or soft-deleted; they either expire naturally or are marked invalid upon logout.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
References the member account that owns this session.

Sessions are exclusively tied to one member account. All session-based authentication and authorization checks resolve the user identity through this foreign key.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
IP address of the client device when the session was created.

Used for security auditing and session anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
Page URL where the session was initiated (e.g., login page URL).

Captures the entry point of the authentication flow.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
Referrer page URL that led the user to the login page.

Used for security auditing and traffic source analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this session was created during login.

Used to determine session age and order sessions chronologically.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this session expires and is no longer valid.

Set to a future time upon creation; sessions past this timestamp are rejected during authentication checks.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery.

This table stores securely generated tokens that allow authenticated members to request password changes when they have lost access to their account. Each token is single-use and time-limited to prevent abuse.

Tokens are cryptographically generated and stored in hashed form for security. The expiration mechanism ensures tokens cannot be used indefinitely, limiting the window of vulnerability if a token is intercepted.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the password reset token record.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the member account requesting the password reset.

A password reset token belongs to exactly one member. This establishes the ownership relationship and allows the system to validate which account a reset token is intended for.

Each member may have only one active (unused, unexpired) reset token at a time, enforced at the application layer.

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description:
Cryptographically hashed password reset token.

This field stores the hash of the actual token sent to the user. The hash prevents token theft from compromising accounts even if the database is breached. The unique constraint ensures no two reset tokens share the same hash value.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Expiration timestamp for the reset token.

Defines the deadline by which the token must be used to initiate a password change. Tokens past this timestamp are considered invalid and cannot be used. Typically set to 24 hours from creation for security.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description:
Optional timestamp indicating when the token was consumed.

When a member successfully completes a password reset using this token, this field is updated with the consumption time. Null indicates the token is still active and unused. Once set, the token is permanently invalidated and cannot be reused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

Recorded automatically upon token generation. Used to calculate token age and support token expiration enforcement.

models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint data.

Guests are unregistered visitors with no authentication credentials. Before signing up, guests are tracked via device fingerprints to maintain pre-registration state. Once a guest signs up and transitions into a registered {@link todo_app_members} account, this guest record is soft-deleted.

Guests exist outside the authenticated user ecosystem and have zero permissions within the application.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest account record.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description:
Unique device fingerprint identifying the guest's browser or device.

This is a computed hash derived from browser characteristics such as user agent, screen resolution, installed fonts, and other browser properties. Used to track the same guest across multiple visits before registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this guest record was first created.

Set when the guest's device is first detected visiting the application.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this guest record was last modified.

Updated on guest record changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this guest record was soft-deleted.

Set when the guest signs up and transitions to a registered {@link todo_app_members} account. Null indicates the guest record is still active.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access to public registration pages.

Tracks ephemeral guest states with device network information, originating URLs, current access paths, and strict expiration timers to ensure secure, unauthenticated browser sessions do not persist indefinitely.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description:
References the guest identity associated with this session.

Links the temporary session token to the specific guest record for tracking device fingerprints and granting access to public pages.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
IP address recorded at session creation.

Used for security tracking, fraud prevention, and validating session network origins.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
URL path or address currently being accessed during the session.

Tracks the specific page or resource the guest is interacting with.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
Referrer URL that led the guest to the accessed page.

Used for analytics, entry point tracing, and security context validation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the guest session was created.

Used for session lifecycle management and calculating session duration.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the guest session expires.

Enforces automatic session termination for security, ensuring unauthenticated states do not persist beyond a safe duration.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
All active and soft-deleted tasks owned by a member.

Users can create, view, complete, edit, and soft-delete or permanently delete. Todos are strictly private to their owner, appearing in personalized lists, trash views, and filtered by completion status or date sorting.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for uniquely identifying a todo.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
The specific registered account that owns this todo.

Establishes strict privacy boundaries so that only the owning member can access their todos. Deletion of a member cascades to permanently remove all associated tasks and their edit histories.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The short text summary of the task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Expanded details or notes for the task.

Optional and can be left empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
The scheduled date and time when the task should begin.

Optional and positioned at the end when sorting by start date.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
The deadline date and time by which the task should be finished.

Optional and positioned at the end when sorting by due date.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description:
Represents the toggle state of task completion.

Defaults to false when initially created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Absolute timestamp recording when the task was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Absolute timestamp recording the last modification made to the task.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Records the exact moment the task was soft-deleted.

Remains null for active tasks.

models.name: todo_app_edit_histories
models.description:
Field-level change audit trail for every edit made to a todo. Records timestamps and new values for all editable fields during a modification event.

Only fields that were actually modified during an edit are recorded; unchanged fields remain null in that history entry. Entries are append-only and permanently deleted when the parent todo is permanently removed from the trash.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each edit history entry.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description:
Links the history entry to the todo that was edited.

Every edit history record belongs to exactly one todo. This foreign key ensures historical changes are associated with their source task, allowing retrieval of a complete chronological audit trail for any specific todo via {@link todo_app_todos}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the edit was made and this history entry was automatically created. Used for reverse-chronological sorting of history entries.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The new title value if the todo's title was changed during an edit. Null if the title was not modified.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The new description value if the todo's description was changed during an edit. Null if the description was not modified.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: The new start date value if the todo's start date was changed during an edit. Null if the start date was not modified.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: The new due date value if the todo's due date was changed during an edit. Null if the due date was not modified.
